Manifest.Name: 可能是改的 / Probably Edited
Manifest.Author: OctoberSama
Manifest.Description: 在模组设置中分类编辑游戏及已启用模组的本地化文本。最多36个可改名的多语言预设，红绿差异对照，单预设JSON分享。通过独立覆盖生效，不改写原文件。本模组不修改字体，可选安装ProbablyFonts改善跨语言显示。推荐安装“游戏内模组设置 / In-Game Mod Settings”，以便游玩时打开编辑器；未安装也可在主菜单独立使用：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3834556946 / Edit localization with named multilingual presets and single-file sharing. ProbablyFonts is optional and handles font fixes separately. In-Game Mod Settings is recommended for in-game access, not required to run.
